Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Tehnologii energetice, Utilități și Servicii IT și consultanță IT
You have a passion for technology and want to make the world a greener place? 
 Join the forefront of energy transition with E.ON Software Development. As a professional services organization, we collaborate closely with our business units, providing pivotal services that accelerate E.ON's ambitious Digital Transformation strategy. 
 It’s on us to make new energy work! 
 In this role, you will take end-to-end responsibility for the support of E.ON Apple Mac devices across our organization. You will oversee the complete support lifecycle, from initial user contact and incident handling through technical resolution, escalation, problem management, and continuous service improvement.
 You will ensure effective collaboration across 1st, 2nd, and 3rd Level Support as well as with internal IT teams, external service providers, and technology partners. Using your expertise in macOS, Jamf Pro, and Microsoft technologies, you will ensure stable operations, consistent service quality, efficient support processes, and a positive user experience.
 Your Role – meaningful & rewarding
Take end-to-end ownership of the Apple Mac support service, including incident handling, technical escalations, problem management, user communication, and continuous service improvement.
Coordinate and oversee the complete support process across all support levels, ensuring clear responsibilities, effective handovers, and timely resolution of user issues.
Act as the central point of accountability for complex and business-critical Mac support cases, coordinating all involved teams, service providers, and technology partners until final resolution.
Ensure consistent service quality and user communication throughout the complete support lifecycle, including regular status updates and transparent escalation management.
Guide, mentor, and enable 1st and 2nd Level Support teams through structured knowledge transfer, technical guidance, documentation, and skills development.
Define, monitor, and continuously improve support processes, service standards, and operational KPIs for the Apple Mac service.
Analyze recurring incidents and service trends, identify root causes, and drive sustainable solutions through problem management, automation, self-service, and self-healing capabilities.
Drive the design, development, implementation, and continuous improvement of AI-powered support, automated self-healing capabilities, and user-friendly self-service solutions in collaboration with internal teams and external partners, reducing recurring incidents and manual effort while improving the user experience.
Collaborate with workplace, network, security, application, and infrastructure teams to provide an integrated support experience and resolve cross-functional issues.
Take end-to-end responsibility for coordinating and steering all service providers involved in the Apple Mac support service, ensuring clear responsibilities, effective collaboration, adherence to agreed SLAs, and continuous improvement of service quality.
Manage technical escalations with external service providers and vendors, ensuring clear ownership, effective coordination, and timely resolution.
Develop and maintain operational documentation, support procedures, user guides, and knowledge base articles for end users and support teams.
Ensure that support requests are accurately documented and tracked within the IT service management system, including ownership, escalation status, resolution, and lessons learned.
 Your Profile – authentic & open-minded
A degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
Extensive hands-on experience in supporting enterprise macOS environments and managing Apple devices with Jamf Pro.
Experience in taking end-to-end responsibility for IT support services, including incident, escalation, and problem management.
Strong understanding of IT service management processes and cross-functional support models.
Proven ability to coordinate internal support teams, external service providers, and technology partners.
Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to manage complex technical issues through to final resolution.
Experience in service optimization, automation, knowledge management, and the development of support processes and KPIs.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills in German and English , including the ability to communicate clearly with users, technical teams, providers, and management.
A proactive and customer-focused approach, with a strong sense of ownership and accountability for service quality and user satisfaction.
Relevant certifications such as Apple Certified Support Professional, Jamf Certified Admin, Jamf 200 or higher, or equivalent qualifications are desirable.
 Our Benefits – smart & useful
 Enjoy flexibility: 
A stable work environment that offers you the flexibility to have a personal and fulfilling work rhythm.
Flexible benefits package – choose what suits you best, from gym memberships to holidays, meals, or shopping vouchers.
 Recharge your battery: 
25 vacation days to help you maintain a healthy work-life balance.
Private medical insurance to support your well-being.
 Advance your development: 
Access to internal learning programs and online learning platforms to grow your skills and career.
 This is by far not all… We are looking forward to speaking with you about further benefits during the hiring process.
